limitations: Simulation prototype: one documented tank-and-pump topology with a single-fault catalogue. It is not certified control software and not field-validated maintenance advice.
Diagnoses are relative to four hypotheses (no fault, reduced pump delivery, tank leak, stuck level sensor); combined or unmodelled faults may be misdiagnosed or reported inconclusive.
Confidence labels are the agent's qualitative judgement, not calibrated probabilities.
Identifiability labels come from a noise-free 4-sigma separability rule applied to single tests, not a formal statistical guarantee.
Usefulness to maintenance trainees and technicians has not been validated with real users.
